svg.text: December 1938 – August 1939 • Nearly 10,000 Unaccompanied Children Rescued Across Europe to Britain

g.text: Sealed steam trains from Berlin, Prague & Vienna
Border crossing into safe transit in Netherlands
Overnight North Sea ferry (Hook of Holland → Harwich)
British boat train to London Liverpool Street Station
Age 9, Vera waved goodbye to Mum and Dad in
Prague with one small suitcase, crossed into the
Netherlands, sailed to Harwich, and met her foster
family at London Liverpool Street Station.
